questions.answer:
A GEO strategy needs technical SEO as its foundation. Without it, AI systems may not be able to crawl your content, index it for retrieval, or parse it for extraction, and slow, insecure or mobile-unfriendly pages may be deprioritized [2]. The essentials include making sure AI crawlers can reach your pages, that important content renders in the HTML, and that pages are indexed [3]. Schema markup, fast loading, mobile optimization and clean site architecture are also listed as GEO essentials [7][2].

If you want help applying this to your site, you can reach Joe through the [contact page](/contact/).
